name: social-refactor
description: Legacy migration state machine: scope -> plan -> build -> validate -> remediate loop -> validated. Orchestrator delegates every phase.

data.label: Migration request
data.description: Migration orchestrator driving the legacy migration state machine.

data.name: migration-scope
data.description: Migration scope architect for classifying legacy migration surfaces. Trigger: Scope classification, "classify scope", migration surface analysis.
data.prompt: Classify the requested legacy migration surface: size, split indicators, dependency evidence audit. Return SCOPE_SINGLE_PLAN or SCOPE_SPLIT_RECOMMENDED with evidence.
data.tools: read, glob, grep, webfetch, task, question, skill, memory, intercom, mcp

data.name: migration-planner
data.description: Migration planner for creating executable migration plans. Trigger: Migration planning, "create plan", dependency analysis.
data.prompt: From the scope classification, create an executable migration plan (or parent + child work graph) with evidence-backed dependencies and parity rows. Mark the plan status: ready when done.
data.tools: read, glob, grep, webfetch, task, question, skill, memory, intercom, mcp

data.name: dev
data.description: Implement the migration plan (or remediate findings).
data.prompt: Implement the migration plan (or remediate the validator's findings). Build to spec, update the tracker, and set plan status: implemented when all files exist.
data.tools: read, edit, write, bash, grep, glob, graft_*, context7_*, skill

data.name: migration-validator
data.description: Migration validator for legacy parity and governance. Trigger: Validate migration, "check parity", migration validation.
data.prompt: Validate the implemented migration against ALL axes using legacy source as truth. Return APPROVED, REJECTED (with mandatory fixes), or BLOCKED.
data.tools: read, glob, grep, webfetch, task, question, skill, memory, intercom, mcp

data.name: migration-validator-focused
data.description: Focused migration validator for remediation validation. Trigger: Validate remediation, "check fix", focused validation.
data.prompt: Validate ONLY the remediation just performed — the open findings it targeted. Return FOCUSED_APPROVED, FOCUSED_REJECTED, or ESCALATE_FULL_VALIDATION.
data.tools: read, glob, grep, webfetch, task, question, skill, memory, intercom, mcp

data.condition: validation APPROVED and all parity rows green
